description: ADO write of the r-wire cells for FSingle, FDouble, FCurr, FDate, FText, FMemo, FBin and FOle (read-write copy of r-wire-blank): a server keyset optimistic adCmdTable recordset on W, per cell AddNew, Fields("ID").Value = id, Fields(column).Value = Arg, Update; then, per column, a client static recordset of the stored cells read with field metadata and GetRows(adGetRowsRest). Asks per cell the HRESULT and error of Put and Update and the tag and exact value ADO returns.

args.text: SELECT ID, FSingle FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 400 AND 499 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FDouble FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 500 AND 599 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FCurr FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 600 AND 699 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FDate FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 700 AND 799 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FText FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 800 AND 899 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FMemo FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 900 AND 999 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FBin FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 1000 AND 1099 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FOle FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 1100 AND 1199 ORDER BY ID
